_comment: What an enrolled device may reach, by name. Each is a host number in every
site's service range, from the bottom band Kubernetes keeps for addresses
chosen by hand: the address plan (modules/infrastructure/address-plan) turns
it into each site's own address, so one line serves every site and no two
The site root hands each address to Flux as ADDRESS_<NAME>, which the Service
of that name sets as its clusterIP - held together by
tests/go/repo/tunnel_routes_test.go, because a route to an address nothing
answers on converges cleanly and reaches nothing. The estate routes each
site's addresses through that site's tunnel (management/estate/site), and
puts every site's in the account-wide split tunnel.
